scripts.text: Izlude is the satellite city of Prontera, capital of the Rune-Midgarts kingdom.
scripts.translation: 依斯魯得是盧恩-米德加茲王國首都普隆德拉的衛星城。

scripts.text: Izlude is key to our kingdom because of the Swordsman Association located here, as well as the fact that Izlude is in charge of protecting the Rune-Midgarts coastline.
scripts.translation: 這裡設有劍士公會，而且依斯魯得負責守護盧恩-米德加茲的海岸線，因此對王國十分重要。

scripts.text: I know, this bridge might look weak and fragile, but it is actually state of the art, built with the most sophisticated technology.
scripts.translation: 我知道，這座橋看起來脆弱不堪，但它其實採用最先進的技術建造，是當今最尖端的工程。

scripts.text: No matter how strong storms may be, or how many people may stand on it, this bridge will NEEEEVER collapse.
scripts.translation: 不管風暴多麼猛烈，也不管橋上站多少人，這座橋絕——對——不——會——塌！

scripts.text: Some people may think Izlude is just a satellite city of Prontera, and not really that important...
scripts.translation: 有些人覺得依斯魯得只是普隆德拉的衛星城，沒什麼特別重要的...

scripts.text: But Izlude is a beautiful town right next to the ocean, as well as beautiful Byalan Island.
scripts.translation: 可是依斯魯得是座緊鄰海洋的美麗城鎮，附近還有美麗的海底洞穴島。

scripts.text: You'll have to board on a ship at the port to get to Byalan Island. There are dangerous dungeons on that island, so don't go snooping around just anywhere.
scripts.translation: 要去海底洞穴島，得從港口搭船。島上有危險的地下城，可別到處亂闖。

scripts.text: Though it is very beautiful, Byalan Island has a mysterious dungeon that extends deep under the sea.
scripts.translation: 海底洞穴島雖然風景優美，卻有一座神秘的地下城，深深延伸至海底。

scripts.text: People who've actually been there have said that if you go deep enough, the dungeon actually descends underwater.
scripts.translation: 去過那裡的人說，只要深入足夠遠，地下城就會延伸到水下。

scripts.text: Surprisingly, once you're underwater, you can breathe just like a fish. Maybe some kind of supernatural force is in effect.
scripts.translation: 令人驚訝的是，到了水下竟然能像魚一樣呼吸。或許是某種超自然力量在起作用。

scripts.text: The people who've seen the underwater view say it is so fantastic that they've kept dreaming of it ever since.
scripts.translation: 見過海底景色的人說，那景象美得不可思議，讓他們至今仍常常夢見。

scripts.text: But unfortunately, the monsters are too strong for ordinary people to merely go sightseeing there. Still, just once, I'd like to go down there...
scripts.translation: 可惜那裡的魔物太強，一般人根本無法去觀光。不過，我還是想至少下去一次...

scripts.text: The Arena here is THE place for capable young people from all over the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom to challenge themselves and test their skills.
scripts.translation: 這裡的競技場是盧恩-米德加茲王國各地年輕能手挑戰自我、檢驗實力的絕佳場所。

scripts.text: You can battle with monsters of differing levels. So, the number of stages you survive will be a testament to your battle prowess.
scripts.translation: 你可以和不同等級的魔物戰鬥。能撐過多少關，就能證明你的戰鬥實力。

scripts.text: The pubs in Prontera are always full of people from local areas and from out-of-town. It can get pretty busy.
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉的酒館總是擠滿本地人和外地來客，熱鬧得很。

scripts.text: It's a pretty good place to stop by for general information and to listen to rumors.
scripts.translation: 那裡很適合打聽訊息、聽聽傳聞。

scripts.text: So if you listen carefully, you just might get lucky and learn some very useful information for yourself.
scripts.translation: 仔細聽的話，說不定能碰巧打聽到對你很有用的情報。

scripts.text: Mt. Mjornir, located north of Prontera, is a tough
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉北方的妙勒尼山脈，山勢險峻，

scripts.text: Aside from the dangers of the mountain itself, insanely vicious insects live there too. I mean, they'll just attack you for no reason.
scripts.translation: 除了山勢本身很危險，那裡還有兇暴得離譜的昆蟲。我是說，它們會無緣無故攻擊你。

scripts.text: If you ever want to visit somewhere past Mt. Mjolnir, then you prepare yourself for the challenge.  Or you could walk around it.
scripts.translation: 如果你想去妙勒尼山脈另一側的地方，就做好迎接挑戰的準備吧。當然也可以繞路。

scripts.text: Some monsters in the world have the unique ability to sense mystical energy, and can detect Magic spells before they are cast.
scripts.translation: 世上有些魔物擁有感知神秘能量的特殊能力，甚至能在魔法施放前察覺到。

scripts.text: Golem of the desert is one of them. Don't underestimate it due to its sluggishness...
scripts.translation: 沙漠裡的石頭人就是其中之一。別因為它動作遲緩就小看它...

scripts.text: If you try to cast magic near it, it will notice and saunter over to smash you. So you better watch out for Golem.
scripts.translation: 如果你在它附近施法，它就會察覺，然後慢悠悠地走來把你砸扁。所以千萬小心石頭人。

scripts.text: There's a very delightful place where you can find every
scripts.translation: 有個非常棒的地方，那裡能見到各種

scripts.text: It's somewhere near the bridge connecting the forest and the desert, on the way to the city of Payon which is Southeast from here.
scripts.translation: 從這裡往東南前往斐揚的路上，在連線森林與沙漠的橋附近。

scripts.text: There are not only pink Porings but also Drops, which can be found at the desert, and the green Poporing.
scripts.translation: 那裡不只有粉色波利，還有沙漠裡常見的水靈波利，以及綠色的波波利。

scripts.text: But be careful, before you realize it, you may come face to face with Ghostring, a deadly Poring that floats around in the air like a ghost.
scripts.translation: 不過要小心，一不留神就可能遇上幽靈波利。它像幽靈一樣飄在空中，是種致命的波利。

scripts.text: Well, of course, they are all very cute, but Ghostring is an EXCEPTION. It is very very dangerous.
scripts.translation: 當然，它們都很可愛，但幽靈波利是個例外。它非常非常危險。

scripts.text: If you are lucky enough, you might even bump into Angeling, the Poring with Angel wings.
scripts.translation: 運氣好的話，你甚至可能遇到長著天使翅膀的天使波利。

scripts.text: Ghostring is a grayish Poring that floats around in the air like a ghost. Just like other ghosts, physical attacks can't do any damage to it.
scripts.translation: 幽靈波利是一種灰色的波利，像幽靈般漂浮在空中。和其他幽靈一樣，物理攻擊對它無效。

scripts.text: Those whose main attack methods are physical like Swordman and Archer might have to run for their lives when facing Ghostrings.
scripts.translation: 以物理攻擊為主的劍士和弓箭手遇到幽靈波利時，恐怕只能逃命。

scripts.text: But don't leave just yet~! There is great news for people with those jobs. Making a weapon of some elemental property is the key.
scripts.translation: 不過先別走~！這些職業也有好訊息。關鍵是製作一把帶有屬性的武器。

scripts.text: This way, even a Swordman or an Archer can inflict damage, the way Magic does, on Ghostrings.
scripts.translation: 這樣一來，劍士或弓箭手也能像魔法一樣對幽靈波利造成傷害。

scripts.text: Angelings are immune to Magic attacks. If people who can only attack with Magic face an Angeling, then it's time for
scripts.translation: 天使波利免疫魔法攻擊。如果只會使用魔法的人遇到天使波利，那就該

scripts.text: If you've got an extra knife or sword, you could give it a shot. But it will be very difficult alone, don't you think?
scripts.translation: 如果你有多餘的短劍或長劍，不妨試試看。不過一個人對付它會很困難吧？

scripts.text: I was thinking, even though the people of Izlude live so close to the ocean...
scripts.translation: 我在想，依斯魯得的人明明住得離海這麼近...

scripts.text: There are other cultures that have completely developed by living off of the sea. Of course, I'm talking about Amatsu.
scripts.translation: 有些地方的人完全依靠海洋發展出了獨特的文化。我說的當然是天津町。

scripts.text: I hear the cuisine there is really good! Although the idea of eating raw fish is new to me, I would love to go there, and try it just once!
scripts.translation: 聽說那裡的料理非常美味！雖然生魚對我來說很新奇，但我真想去嘗一次！

scripts.text: Here in Izlude, we are responsible for maintaining peace not only on land but also at sea. That's why this city has a huge telescope.
scripts.translation: 在依斯魯得，我們不僅要維護陸地上的和平，也要守護海上的安寧。所以城裡才有一架巨大的望遠鏡。

scripts.text: This telescope constantly watches over the sea, so that we can prevent any serious trouble from happening. You know...
scripts.translation: 這架望遠鏡會持續監視海面，防止發生嚴重事故。你知道...

scripts.text: The only skill that's needed for a Swordman is ^FF2400Bash^000000! Bash, Bash and ONLY ^FF2400Bash^000000! No need to waste time and effort for smaller skills! Everything else is for cowards and wusses!
scripts.translation: 劍士只需要^FF2400狂擊^000000這一招！狂擊、狂擊、只要^FF2400狂擊^000000！別把時間和精力浪費在小技能上！其他技能都是膽小鬼和軟蛋才用的！

scripts.text: What are you talking about!? The ideal Swordman resolutely stands alone, surrounded by countless enemies and smashing them all with one awesome attack.
scripts.translation: 你在說什麼！？理想的劍士應該孤身一人，面對無數敵人，以一記強力攻擊將他們全部擊倒。

scripts.text: Well... Sometimes the explosive damage might accidentally hit some wandering monsters, and those guys end up coming after you, but that's a risk a Swordman should be willing to take!!
scripts.translation: 呃...有時候爆炸會誤傷路過的魔物，結果它們反過來追你。不過這就是劍士應該承擔的風險！！

scripts.text: That's exactly why you're dumb, you idiot! And what's this about the 'the ideal Swordman?' I still remember the last time you used Magnum Break...
scripts.translation: 你這笨蛋就是因為這樣才蠢！還說什麼“理想的劍士”？我還記得你上次用怒爆的時候...

scripts.text: You ended up running away from all those monsters you hit with that stupid skill! Weakling! All those Porings around you got hit and they all tried to kill you.
scripts.translation: 結果你被那個笨技能打中的魔物追得到處逃！弱者！周圍的波利都被你打中了，還一起追殺你。

scripts.text: Hmpf. As I recall, you were running away too, apparently too busy to use your precious Bash. In any case, Magnum Break is THE skill for a Swordman~!!
scripts.translation: 哼。我記得你也在逃跑，看來是忙得沒空用你寶貝的狂擊。總之，怒爆才是劍士的絕招~！！

scripts.text: is just one of the little steps towards Magnum Break.
scripts.translation: 不過是邁向怒爆的一小步。

scripts.text: Which one do you think is better? The critical damage skill, ^FF2400Bash^000000, or the Splash damage skill, ^EE0000Magnum Break^000000?
scripts.translation: 你覺得哪招更好？是能造成暴擊傷害的^FF2400狂擊^000000，還是能造成範圍傷害的^EE0000怒爆^000000？

scripts.text: Hahahaha!!! I knew you'd see things my way!! You ARE a great guy!! Undoubtedly, only ^FF2400Bash^000000 suits a Swordman. Please tell that to this BONEHEAD over here~ Hahaha!
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈哈！！！我就知道你會贊同我！！你真是個好人！！毫無疑問，劍士只適合用^FF2400狂擊^000000。快告訴這個笨蛋吧~哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Hmm, let me give you a bit of advice. After you achieve level 5 'Bash', the amount of SP consumed by the skill increases greatly, so watch out for your SP.
scripts.translation: 嗯，給你一點建議。狂擊達到5級後，技能消耗的SP會大幅增加，要留意SP。

scripts.text: Hahahaha!! See!? Someone who pursues a different job agrees with me~! You really are a great guy! Hahaha!! Undoubtedly, only ^FF2400Bash^000000 suits a Swordman. Please tell that to this NIMROD over here~ Hahaha!
scripts.translation: 哈哈哈哈！！看見沒！？連別的職業的人都同意我~！你真是個好人！哈哈哈！！毫無疑問，劍士只適合用^FF2400狂擊^000000。快告訴這個白痴吧~哈哈哈！

scripts.text: Alright!! ^EE0000Magnum Break^000000 is the BEST!! Now you're talking~!! You know the stuff~ HaHaHa!
scripts.translation: 沒錯！！^EE0000怒爆^000000才是最棒的！！這才像話~！！你真懂行~哈哈哈！

scripts.text: You wanna know some useful information? Okay, okay lemme tell ya! Magnum Break has Fire Property.
scripts.translation: 想聽點有用的情報？好吧好吧，我告訴你！怒爆是火屬性技能。

scripts.text: So it won't be too effective against monsters with the Water property, but this is THE skill to use against Undead and Earth property monsters!
scripts.translation: 所以對水屬性魔物效果不太好，但對不死屬性和地屬性魔物，這招可是絕佳技能！

scripts.text: And most importantly, look around before you use it. Otherwise you'll be in BIG trouble~
scripts.translation: 最重要的是，使用前先看看周圍。否則你可就麻煩大了~

scripts.text: Right?! ^EE0000Magnum Break^000000 is THE BEST!!! You know what you're talking about, eh? I don't know why this jerkface is being sooooo stubborn.
scripts.translation: 對吧？！^EE0000怒爆^000000最棒！！！你真有眼光。我真不懂這混蛋為什麼這麼頑固。

scripts.text: Oh shut up. And those were Poporings. As I recall, you were running away too, apparently too busy to use your precious Bash.

scripts.translation: 我說得對吧？！^EE0000怒爆^000000最棒！！！你真有眼光。我真不懂這個胖子為什麼這麼頑固。

scripts.text: Huh? Why am I so happy?
Ah~~ There's not much for us to do these days. You see, Merchants buy items dropped by monsters. But you knew that, right?
scripts.translation: 啊~~我們最近沒什麼事做。你知道，商人會收購魔物掉落的物品，對吧？

scripts.text: HaHa~ In fact, that was actually part of our job. But there were more and more hunters who came to us in order to get paid and it became too much to handle.
scripts.translation: 哈哈~其實這原本也是我們的工作。但來找我們領取報酬的獵人越來越多，我們忙不過來了。

scripts.text: We had to work overtime every day. Ah, it was a nightmare...! Anyway, the government eventually made a wise decision in creating the Registration System.
scripts.translation: 我們每天都得加班。啊，簡直是噩夢...！後來政府總算做了明智的決定，設立了登記制度。

scripts.text: The Office of Prize Compensation only pays those who have the Registration. Of course, you'd have to be a merchant and stay in the same place all day long.
scripts.translation: 報酬補償處只向持有登記資格的人支付報酬。當然，你必須是商人，而且整天待在同一個地方。

scripts.text: The Office gives away the registration to any merchant who fulfills those requirements. So nowadays, the hunters sell their goods to the registered merchants.
scripts.translation: 符合這些條件的商人都能向補償處登記。所以現在獵人會把戰利品賣給登記商人。

scripts.text: So nowadays, the hunters sell their goods to the registered merchants.  Not too many people come to us for that anymore.
scripts.translation: 如今獵人都把戰利品賣給登記商人了。來找我們處理這事的人也少了很多。

scripts.text: I mean we are still busy, but that's nothing compared to how it was before. People who have felt suffering know how to appreciate even the slightest comfort.
scripts.translation: 我們現在還是忙，不過跟以前比已經輕鬆多了。吃過苦的人才懂得珍惜一點點安逸。

scripts.text: What?! What do you mean you didn't know?! Well, you know you can get items by killing monsters. If you bring and sell those to a merchant, you can make some money.
scripts.translation: 什麼？！你說你不知道？！打倒魔物就能獲得物品，把它們拿去賣給商人就能賺到錢。

scripts.text: HaHa, in fact, that used to be part of our job. But there were more and more hunters who come in order to get paid, so it became too much to handle.
scripts.translation: 哈哈，這原本也是我們的工作。但來領取報酬的獵人越來越多，我們忙不過來了。

scripts.text: The Office gives away the registration to any merchant who fulfills those requirements. So nowadays, the hunters sell their goods to the registered merchants.
scripts.translation: 符合這些條件的商人都能向補償處登記。所以現在獵人會把戰利品賣給登記商人。

scripts.text: So nowadays, the hunters sell their goods to the registered merchants.  Not too many people come to us for that anymore.
scripts.translation: 如今獵人都把戰利品賣給登記商人了。來找我們處理這事的人也少了很多。

scripts.text: I mean we are still busy, but that's nothing compared to how it was before. People who have felt suffering know how to appreciate even the slightest comfort.
scripts.translation: 我們現在還是忙，不過跟以前比已經輕鬆多了。吃過苦的人才懂得珍惜一點點安逸。

scripts.text: Don't you think Strong VIT and training in a unique breathing method which enables quick HP recovery are the greatest advantages for a Swordman?
scripts.translation: 你不覺得高VIT，以及通過特殊呼吸法快速恢復HP，是劍士最大的優勢嗎？

scripts.text: If you train your skills very hard, you can even see your HP recovering. The amount
scripts.translation: 刻苦訓練技能後，你甚至能看到HP恢復。恢復量

scripts.text: So if you invest more of your stats in VIT, you'll recover more HP overall when resting.
scripts.translation: 所以把更多屬性點投入VIT，休息時就能恢復更多HP。

scripts.text: But of course, it'd be good to have high Attack, wouldn't it? You can either acquire a good weapon or bring up your STR to support you Attack.
scripts.translation: 當然，攻擊力高也不錯吧？你可以找一把好武器，或提升STR來增強攻擊力。

scripts.text: You know you'll need some strength anyway to swing good weapons easily, anyway.
scripts.translation: 畢竟要輕鬆揮舞好武器，也得有足夠的力量。

scripts.text: Another important thing is how accurate you can hit your opponents. DEX is the key here. If you train DEX, then the gap between the MIN and MAX damage will also decrease.
scripts.translation: 另一個重點是命中對手的準確度，這就要看DEX了。提升DEX還能縮小最低與最高傷害之間的差距。

scripts.text: Are you bored by all this talk? Or do you want me to go on?
scripts.translation: 這些話讓你覺得無聊了嗎？還是要我繼續說？

scripts.text: In that case, I'll explain about the other attributes to you briefly. In order to attack and evade quickly, you've gotta pay attention to AGI.
scripts.translation: 那我簡單介紹一下其他屬性。想要快速攻擊和閃避，就得注意AGI。

scripts.text: In case you want to make more critical hits, it's a good idea to invest in LUK. INT also increases Max SP, which is needed to use various skills... But it's really up to you.
scripts.translation: 想提高暴擊率的話，投入一些LUK會很有幫助。INT也能提升使用各種技能所需的最大SP...不過還是由你決定。
